note: Issue #203: the Remnant general in a story save (src/systems/npc/general_post.gd). Where he stands: in the pit while the story is at the 'general' chapter ('pit'), else in the barracks yard ('barracks'): a town marker plus an offset; his guard and assassin droid stand at offsets from him. 'insult_standing': Remnant standing each insult costs; 'search_after': insults in one talk before his guards search you (the gate's rules). Issue #204: 'droid_kind' he buys for 'pay_mult' times the droid merchant's resale, each one raising Remnant standing by 'droid_standing'; 'tip_standing': at or above it he tells you about the crashed cruiser (issue #205). 'armour_outfit': his look once the Remnant has left (issue #214). Issue #251: his second job (j_general_repossess) is contraband stashed inside the town; handing it over on his [E] menu pays what the fence would and raises Remnant standing by 'contraband_standing'. Story fixes: 'face': the marker he, his guard and his droid face (the front gate). 'meeting': the pit meeting ends only on his verdict, let_go or search (the player cannot leave on Esc); each sets the Remnant standing you start with ('standing'); after 'turns' of his replies with no verdict the game gives one (search if you insulted him, else let go); 'end_delay' seconds after the verdict the talk closes; 'after' seconds later T-89 may greet you. Barracks fight: in the barracks yard (before the Remnant leave) he and his guard are garrison troopers ('squad': soldier profiles 'general' and 'guard') and his assassin droid a Remnant droid ('squad.droid', DroidController), so they can be killed and they fight on the town alarm. Killed there he is gone for good (flag general_dead): a bounty not yet taken on him goes to an officer instead, and the end card says he is dead.

lines.searched_clean: Search this one! ... Clean. This time.
lines.no_work: I have no work for enemies of the Remnant. Get out of my sight.
lines.job_taken: Bring me assassin droids from the desert. I pay %d a head.
lines.paid: A fine machine. %d credits. The Hegemony thanks you.
lines.repossessed: Confiscated, as the law requires. %d credits. The garrison will put it to better use.
lines.tip: Spacer... you have earned this. Go and see the cruiser that crashed out on the horizon. Even in the sand she is magnificent. I walk her halls sometimes, to remember being a private. There is something red still aboard.
lines.let_go: Go on, then. T-89 is in the pit. Don't make me regret it.
lines.meeting_clean: Clean. Get out of my sight.
lines.hold: %s has not dismissed you. Answer him.
lines.brief: THIS IS THE PIT MEETING: they have just climbed out of their ship and they cannot walk away until you decide. Bully them for a minute, then end it with ONE of: let_go (let them go on to T-89) or search (your guards search them; do this if they were insolent or you don't trust them). Decide by your third reply at the latest. Never use end_conversation now.
lines.killed: %s is dead. The Remnant will not forget it.
